LanguageData.MT_MakeModule_FireControl.label: make precision fire control module
LanguageData.MT_MakeModule_FireControl.description: Manufacture a precision fire control module that adds various features to a turret. The description is way too long, though... By default, it improves turret and weapon accuracy and prevents friendly fire. Targets in aggressive mental states are excluded from protection. For mortar turrets, it also prevents direct and blast damage to buildings belonging to your faction. However, this module does not work perfectly in every situation.
LanguageData.MT_MakeHead_Autocannon.label: make autocannon head
LanguageData.MT_MakeHead_Autocannon.description: Manufacture an autocannon main head. The most basic turret of the bunch, and the foundation for almost every other upper turret assembly. Mother...f...(turning to dust)
LanguageData.MT_MakeHead_Sniper.label: make sniper cannon head
LanguageData.MT_MakeHead_Sniper.description: Manufacture a sniper cannon main head. Pushes the autocannon's firepower to the limit at the cost of fire rate.
LanguageData.MT_MakeHead_DualAutocannon.label: make dual autocannon head
LanguageData.MT_MakeHead_DualAutocannon.description: Manufacture a dual autocannon main head. Two of anything is always better—though in Warcraft, splitting one sword into two wasn't such a hot idea.
LanguageData.MT_MakeHead_DualSniper.label: make dual sniper cannon head
LanguageData.MT_MakeHead_DualSniper.description: Manufacture a dual sniper cannon main head. It may look like a CIWS, but don't expect it to act like one.
LanguageData.MT_MakeHead_DualMortar.label: make dual mortar head
LanguageData.MT_MakeHead_DualMortar.description: Manufacture a dual mortar main head. A mortar turret with all the headaches of a vanilla mortar stripped right out.
LanguageData.MT_MakeHead_Flamethrower.label: make flamethrower head
LanguageData.MT_MakeHead_Flamethrower.description: Manufacture a flamethrower main head. Nothing like a good Zergling roast.
LanguageData.MT_MakeHead_Minigun.label: make minigun head
LanguageData.MT_MakeHead_Minigun.description: Manufacture a minigun main head. An upper turret assembly that prides itself on a blistering rate of fire.
LanguageData.MT_MakeHead_Laser.label: make laser cannon head
LanguageData.MT_MakeHead_Laser.description: Manufacture a laser cannon main head. Fries your enemies with a high-powered laser. And your allies, if necessary.
LanguageData.MT_MakeHead_Missile.label: make missile launcher head
LanguageData.MT_MakeHead_Missile.description: Manufacture a missile launcher main head. Unleashes a swarm of missiles. Do not operate while walled in from the front.
LanguageData.MT_MakeHead_Tesla.label: make Tesla coil head
LanguageData.MT_MakeHead_Tesla.description: Manufacture a Tesla coil main head. No, not the car company that wants to fly—it's named after Nikola Tesla. Oh, and the visual motif is a musical Tesla coil!
LanguageData.MT_MakeHead_Quantum.label: make quantum cannon head
LanguageData.MT_MakeHead_Quantum.description:
Manufacture a quantum cannon main head. The flagship top-tier turret assembly of this mod. When needed, it ignores certain shields to deliver a pinpoint strike straight into the target...
kind of like Ant-Man flying up Thanos's rear end and expanding.
LanguageData.MT_MakeModule_Range.label: make range radar module
LanguageData.MT_MakeModule_Range.description: Manufacture a range radar module. A bizarre radar that spins when mounted on top, yet stays completely still when bolted to the sides.
LanguageData.MT_MakeModule_Shield.label: make shield module
LanguageData.MT_MakeModule_Shield.description: Manufacture a shield module. Adds a light protective barrier to the turret.
LanguageData.MT_MakeModule_Auxiliary.label: make auxiliary autocannon module
LanguageData.MT_MakeModule_Auxiliary.description: Manufacture an auxiliary autocannon module. Bolts on an extra autocannon with its own independent firing cycle. Expect it to fire off-beat all the time.
LanguageData.MT_MakeModule_Aiming.label: make aiming assistant module
LanguageData.MT_MakeModule_Aiming.description: Manufacture an aiming assistant module. Looks suspiciously like a Terran Ghost painting a target for a nuclear strike.
LanguageData.MT_MakeModule_Cooling.label: make coolant module
LanguageData.MT_MakeModule_Cooling.description: Manufacture a coolant module. Rapidly cools the weapon to shorten the firing cycle. Water cooling beats air cooling after all.
LanguageData.MT_MakeModule_Fan.label: make tracking servo module
LanguageData.MT_MakeModule_Fan.description: Manufacture a tracking servo that accelerates turret target-tracking rotation. The ultimate dream is strapping a guy inside and spinning him around like a maniac, just like a Terran Missile Turret.
LanguageData.MT_MakeModule_SpecialistAutocannon.label: make autocannon fuse chamber module
LanguageData.MT_MakeModule_SpecialistAutocannon.descr:
These maniacs finally figured out how to load literal bombs as bullets!
Replaces each round with an explosive impact of radius 1.4 cells. Targets take up to the round damage, with less damage toward the blast edge; no additional direct-hit damage is added. Fits the left, right or top slot only on the autocannon and dual autocannon. It is manufactured complete and cannot be upgraded. Only one copy of the same dedicated module may be installed or queued on a turret. Auxiliary weapons are unaffected. Installation and removal each require 100 construction work. Removal has the normal 1% failure chance.
LanguageData.MT_MakeModule_SpecialistSniper.label: make sniper penetrator core module
LanguageData.MT_MakeModule_SpecialistSniper.descripti:
Strategically relocates fin-stabilized sabot rounds straight through the target—and the next couple of guys behind them.
Rounds continue through up to 3 targets along their flight path. Each further penetration retains 70% of the previous damage. Solid walls and shields stop the round. Fits the left, right or top slot only on the sniper cannon and dual sniper cannon. It is manufactured complete and cannot be upgraded. Only one copy of the same dedicated module may be installed or queued on a turret. Auxiliary weapons are unaffected. Installation and removal each require 100 construction work. Removal has the normal 1% failure chance.
LanguageData.MT_MakeModule_SpecialistMinigun.label: make minigun cycle drive module
LanguageData.MT_MakeModule_SpecialistMinigun.descript:
Frequent jams cut the burst length down, but hey, it cools down way faster now. Looks like a botched overclock.
Warmup and post-burst cooldown are reduced to 25% (1/4) of normal, while each burst also fires 25% (1/4) as many rounds (minimum 1). Time between rounds is unchanged. Fits the left, right or top slot only on the minigun. It is manufactured complete and cannot be upgraded. Only one copy of the same dedicated module may be installed or queued on a turret. Auxiliary weapons are unaffected. Installation and removal each require 100 construction work. Removal has the normal 1% failure chance.
LanguageData.MT_MakeModule_SpecialistQuantum.label: make quantum field stabilizer module
LanguageData.MT_MakeModule_SpecialistQuantum.descript:
A module that sells you a feature the gun really should have had at launch, packaged as paid DLC.
Sets the main weapon armor penetration to at least 100%. Higher penetration from upgrades is retained. Fits the left, right or top slot only on the quantum cannon. It is manufactured complete and cannot be upgraded. Only one copy of the same dedicated module may be installed or queued on a turret. Auxiliary weapons are unaffected. Installation and removal each require 100 construction work. Removal has the normal 1% failure chance.
LanguageData.MT_MakeModule_SpecialistFlamethrower.des:
Somehow, panicking when you're literally on fire was carved out into a separate add-on module.
A flame hit has a 20% chance to make a living flesh target flee for up to 6 seconds; reaching safety may end it earlier. This temporary combat reaction does not affect targets already in a mental state, mechanoids or buildings. Fits the left, right or top slot only on the flamethrower. It is manufactured complete and cannot be upgraded. Only one copy of the same dedicated module may be installed or queued on a turret. Auxiliary weapons are unaffected. Installation and removal each require 100 construction work. Removal has the normal 1% failure chance.
LanguageData.MT_MakeModule_SpecialistLaser.label: make laser disruption optics module
LanguageData.MT_MakeModule_SpecialistLaser.descriptio:
Scatters the laser beam inside the target on impact, scoring bonus internal hits.
After dealing actual damage, a hit has a 20% chance to apply 50% of its base damage again to the struck body part. If the target survives, it also applies one secondary hit worth 25% of base damage to a valid torso or internal organ. Each extra hit still checks armor; fully absorbed primary hits trigger neither effect. This does not forcibly delete limbs. Fits the left, right or top slot only on the laser cannon. It is manufactured complete and cannot be upgraded. Only one copy of the same dedicated module may be installed or queued on a turret. Auxiliary weapons are unaffected. Installation and removal each require 100 construction work. Removal has the normal 1% failure chance.
LanguageData.MT_MakeModule_SpecialistTesla.label: make Tesla pulse capacitor module
LanguageData.MT_MakeModule_SpecialistTesla.descriptio:
Now with added muscle-relaxing tension relief built right into your electro-therapy session. Enjoy the massage!
After dealing actual damage, pulses can stun each target for up to 2 seconds. A shared 5-second recovery period prevents repeated application by multiple turrets; normal stun immunity is retained. Fits only the left or right slot of a Tesla head. It is manufactured complete and cannot be upgraded. Only one copy of the same dedicated module may be installed or queued on a turret. Auxiliary weapons are unaffected. Installation and removal each require 100 construction work. Removal has the normal 1% failure chance.
